The desktop app brings its own helpers, draws its own title bar and keeps its console windows to itself.

## ✨ Added

- **The desktop app brings ffmpeg, 7-Zip and MuPDF along.** The installer fetches them on Windows and Linux, the Mac app has them inside, and they update together with the app. Thumbnails, videos, 7z archives and PDF pages work without installing anything else. Settings > Info shows the versions and fetches a missing one.
- **Windows on ARM gets an installer of its own.**
- **The container packs RAR archives** on amd64. It carries RARLAB's rar, licence included. Reading and unpacking RAR works everywhere, as before.
- **An OLED switch right under the theme puts the dark look on true black,** for OLED and AMOLED screens. While Light is chosen it stays where it is and says why, and every browser keeps its own choice.

## 🎨 Design

- **On Windows and Linux the window draws its own title bar** in the house style, with dragging, edge resizing and snapping as before. The Mac keeps its own.
- **The window, the taskbar and the installer show the logo on its own**, without the tile behind it.
- **The sign-in card writes "Name" and "Password" inside the fields,** in grey until the first key, as GlimStone draws it for every app.
- **The "Stay signed in" switch is gone from the sign-in card.** A sign-in lasts as long as your account sets under Account & security.
- **A struck-out shortcut explains itself in its tooltip** instead of a line under the row.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Windows comes as an installer only.** The portable download is gone, and copies already installed keep updating as before.
- **CannonCommander follows GlimStone 4.3.7.**
- **CannonCommander builds with Go 1.27.4**, which fixes a crash in Go's HTTP server (GO-2026-6859).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **No more console windows popping up on Windows.** Every helper the app started, down to one per thumbnail, opened a window of its own. Programs you start yourself, such as a batch file, still get theirs.
- **The container shows PDF pages.** It carried the MuPDF library, but not the program the page view calls.
- **The compose file lets rclone mount remote storage on Debian and Ubuntu hosts,** whose AppArmor profile refused FUSE mounts even with SYS_ADMIN.
